author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring Freelance Artists for Character Design, Illustration, Backgrounds
content: HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS. Avetetsuya Studios is currently opening opportunities for freelance artists to collaborate on various upcoming projects. We are looking for artists with skills in: -Character Design & Illustration -Character Sprites -Background & Environment Art -Webtoon / Comic Artwork -Game & Digital Art Assets -Other illustration and visual development. Qualifications: strong portfolio, good drawing fundamentals, ability to follow art direction or adapt to various visual styles, good anatomy/composition/color, meet deadlines, accept feedback and revisions, professional communication and reliable work ethic. How to apply: send portfolio and short introduction to avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com. Subject: Freelance Artist Application – [Your Name]. Also include types of artwork you master or are interested in, art style, availability, freelance rate.

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted — Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: craiggroshek@chillingtalesfordarknights.com. Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST.
